headlines.description: — The Atlanta Braves will have left-hander Ray Kerr make his first career postseason appearance as the opener against the Philadelphia Phillies in Thursday night's decisive game of the NL Wild Card Series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves announce left-hander Ray Kerr to start against Phillies' Aaron Nola in NL Wild Card Series

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — From 100 losses to their first playoff series win in two decades, these scrappy Chicago White Sox just keep outdoing themselves.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox pounce early, finish sweep of Astros for first playoff series win since 2005

events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — One year after rallying past the Red Sox to win an AL Wild Card Series, the New York Yankees battered Boston.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fried, Bellinger and García lead Yankees over Red Sox 9-2 for 2-game Wild Card Series sweep

events.name: Chicago Cubs at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Gavin Sheets blasted a two-run homer, five Padres pitchers combined on a five-hitter, and San Diego swept the Chicago Cubs out of the NL Wild Card Series with a 4-1 victory in Game 2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gavin Sheets' pinch-hit homer propels dominant Padres past Cubs 4-1 for 2-game Wild Card sweep
